messages:
jess: FYI, publish for sample-app failed on release pipeline due to a regendiff. Looks like a pure property-ordering churn inside generated types, blocking the npm step.

dev-bot: [CI] workflow: release/sample-app (#519) failed 1: regendiff detected in packages/sample-app/src/gen/types.ts

jess: snippet from regendiff: 
```
- export type Project = { id: string; description?: string; name: string }
+ export type Project = { name: string; description?: string; id: string }
```

noah: this is the nondet ordering we keep hitting when optional fields are emitted. It flips between builds depending on insertion order upstream.

liam: quick questions: are we running the same codegen and typegen versions in CI as locally? if not, pinning might make the CI reproducible.

jess: CI shows @redwood/codegen@3.3.0 and @redwood/typegen@2.0.0 in the lockfile. local dev machine has 3.3.1 -> suspect a patch caused different emission order.

noah: short-term fix I can push: add a tiny "normalize-generated" step that runs after regen to stable-sort object keys and array elements in generated files. That should make regendiff a no-op for ordering-only diffs.

liam: prefer we also avoid stamping a semver bump for generator-only ordering diffs. Release stamp currently bumps patch for any regendiff. If the only changes match an ordering-only regex, we should skip bump. Risky but okay with strong tests.

jess: for immediate unblock, please open a PR that either normalizes generated outputs or pins the exact codegen/typegen binaries in the sample-app workspace.

noah: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/519: adds scripts/normalize-gen.js, plugs it into prepublish CI, and pins codegen to 3.3.1. Also added a regen-smoke job that runs regen twice to detect nondet runs.

dev-bot: CI started for PR #519.

liam: quick review: normalize-gen.js okay but move it under tools/ and run via `node tools/normalize-gen.js`. Also please add a test that runs regen twice and fails if diffs appear.

noah: updated PR accordingly. Added tests/regendiff-smoke.test.js which runs the regen script twice and asserts git status clean.

dev-bot: CI green for PR #519.

jess: merging and re-running release pipeline now. cc @release-ninja.

release-ninja: re-run kicked off. publish step now reached. No regendiff found. Publish completed, sample-app v1.5.2 published.

liam: follow-up tasks: 1) RFC to add an ordering-normalizer into the typegen pipeline, 2) consider marking pure ordering-only diffs as non-release-bumping in release-stamp, 3) add a codegen pinning policy for sample/workspaces.

noah: I'll file the RFC and link the PR in the ticket.

jess: thanks team. Leaving this thread open until the RFC lands, but unblocked for the release. :tada:
